text:
mira: midnight check-in: finished kernel queueing experiment. microburst tail improved ~12% p99 with a small slot-reserve tweak. ran bench-suite v2 on canary, logs in /runs/3456. no deploy yet.
sam: nice — what's the knob? was it the slot_reserve param? any reg tests?
mira: yeah slot_reserve 0.12 -> 0.18, plus small batching jitter to avoid synchronized wakes. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/6789. perf numbers attached in the PR. planning a larger stress sweep tomorrow.
alex: re: KV cache — noticed increased eviction during the same window. looks like shared LRU pressure across models. will try per-model LRU buckets to isolate traffic; opening issue #4512.
mira: noted. blockers: need a very quick sanity review on the kernel scheduler patch before promoting — it's tiny: ~6 LOC + tests. @alex @sam can you glance? link in PR.
sam: will take a look in ~30m. fyi CI flaky on microburst test, timeout intermittently. I added a retry to the job config.
ci-bot: Build #4521 completed: flaky-tests rerun passed. Artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/4521/kernel-bench/
alex: skimmed the PR and left 2 nits. main suggestion: add a comment explaining why jitter uses exponential backoff rather than linear. otherwise LGTM.
mira: thanks — will address nits and merge after CI. tomorrow's plan: run 4-node perf sweep with quantized variants, capture p50/p95/p99, and validate KV hit-rate with the per-model LRU simulation.
sam: I'll add a dashboard tile for queue_drain_time_ms so we can correlate with KV evictions and scheduling changes.
mira: sounds good. thinking of canary rollout: 5% for 1h then 20% for 2h. objections?
alex: +1. also add automatic fallback to previous scheduler if p99 spikes > 25% over baseline.
mira: added fallback config in the rollout yaml. snippet:
```yaml
rollout:
  canary: 5%
  step: [5,20]
  fallback_on: p99 > 1.25
```
sam: lgtm. I think my blocker (CI flakiness) is cleared for now.
mira: thanks team. if no objections I'll merge after the CI rerun tonight. good night :crescent_moon:
ops: noted for tomorrow's run — reserved capacity allocated: gpu-pool-3 for 4 hours starting 02:00 UTC.
